title: Augmenting Ultrasound Imaging in Order to Replace Fluoroscopy in Image Guided Pain Procedures
brief_summary: Utilizing existing data from CT/MRI images of patients, the investigators wish to develop an algorithm for augmenting the image obtained by ultrasound. In order to improved injection by ultrasound guidance
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

Patients with low back pain including lower / upper back pain. Patients who underwent MRI or CT imaging of the lower back during the past year.

Patients who can understand the rationale of the study and can sign an informed consent form.

Exclusion Criteria:

Patients who have undergone back surgery in the lower back area Patients with significant deformity (deformity) in the back such as scoliosis with an angle above 50 degrees
study_population: Patients who are referred to the Rambam Institute of Pain Medicine suffering from low back pain and who have already undergone a CT scan or MRI examination of the lower back before arriving at the Institute
